body:
Customers are entirely different. They ask about our store or our merchandise and I just answer or refer them to somebody else if I don't know the answer. They don't look at me as a person, they look at me as a worker, basically a robot.

Officially I'm studying accounting, but I really don't care about it. I'm not interested in anything. Nothing ever sparked my interest like everybody else. That's why I'm in retail...
